# LeanPool finite cyclic surface classification foundation

These 106 additional modules are adapted from [LeanPool/lean-pool](https://github.com/LeanPool/lean-pool), commit `86da5902e640ceb44e53f88c4a04f870dc062126`. Nine already verified modules from the same commit are reused without changes.

Copyright © 2026 ClassificationOfSurfaces contributors. Authors: Ryan McCorvie and Jack McCarthy. Original copyright and author headers remain in every source. The complete Apache-2.0 license remains in [the shared LeanPool license](../LICENSE).

The imported theorem concerns valid connected finite cyclic edge presentations and their actual polygonal quotient realizations. It constructs a genuine homeomorphism to a sphere, orientable polygon quotient or nonorientable polygon quotient, including surfaces with boundary. It supplies a prerequisite; the project must separately identify the original Fuchsian side gluing, derive closedness and orientability, match its actual genus models, and prove the actual Euler and area formula. These consequences are not inferred from upstream comments.

Changes are project-relative module names, explicit public imports and sections, and one deprecated `linearMap_vsub` call replaced by `linear_apply_vsub` in `Moise/CommonSubdivision.lean`. The main classification entry name, theorem statements and author credits are retained. Forty-eight duplicated support helpers in the newly imported PolygonalSchoenflies module have the unique `finiteClassification_` prefix; its PLApproximation references are updated. This allows the complete library to coexist with the unchanged existing PolygonalDiskDeletion module and its already used declarations. The exact old/new helper names are recorded in the provenance file. Harmless upstream informational tactic suggestions remain recorded in the actual diagnostic gate; they are not errors or warnings. `FINITE_CLASSIFICATION_UPSTREAM.json` records exact original Git blobs, original and local hashes, changes and per-file all-local axiom gate counts. Existing project source modules and already mapped Graph interfaces are unchanged.
